daisyBed.name: Daisy Bed

daisyBed.inspector: Daisies leave one at a time from the side it faces.

lavenderBed.name: Lavender Bed
lavenderBed.tooltip: Grows one sprig at a time, from the side you aim. Lavender takes longer than daisies.

belt.name: Belt
belt.tooltip: Carries one item per tile, only in the direction it faces.

bundlingTable.name: Bundling Table
bundlingTable.tooltip: Ties 2 daisies into one Daisy Bundle.
bundlingTable.inspector: Takes daisies from any side, and bundles leave the way it faces.

dryingBench.name: Drying Bench

dryingBench.inspector: Takes lavender from any side, and sachets leave the way it faces.

arrangementTable.name: Arrangement Table
arrangementTable.tooltip: Makes a Mixed Bouquet from one bundle and one sachet.
arrangementTable.inspector: Takes a bundle and a sachet from any side, and bouquets leave the way it faces.

packingStation.name: Packing Station
packingStation.tooltip: Takes deliveries and counts them toward the open order.
packingStation.inspector: Takes a delivery from any side and counts it toward the order. Nothing comes back out.

remove.name: Remove

mixedBouquet.line: 1 Daisy Bundle + 1 Lavender Sachet to 1 Mixed Bouquet

tutorial.skipped: Tips are hidden. Open How to Play to read them again.

opening.prompt: Nell's order at the top is 2 daisies, and they count only when they reach the Packing Station.
Open Build and place a Daisy Bed on open grass, where the daisies grow. Press R to aim the side they leave from.
Choose Packing Station and place it a few tiles away. A daisy counts only if it arrives there.
Choose Belt and drag from the bed to the Packing Station. Each tile holds one item and moves it forward.
Press R to turn a belt. Keep the tiles touching, so each item has a next step.
Wait a few seconds for a daisy to move onto the belt. If it stops, the status line says why.
Send 2 daisies to the Packing Station. The order updates on its own, then pays you.
Press Z to undo a build. Remove sends items to the basket, and Esc or right-click cancels.

bundles.prompt: Otto wants Daisy Bundles, so place a Bundling Table on the belt path. It needs 2 daisies.

more-bundles.prompt: Hester wants 4 bundles. Add a second Daisy Bed and belt it to the Bundling Table.

lavender.prompt: Ivo wants raw lavender, so place a Lavender Bed and belt it to the Packing Station. Lavender takes longer than daisies.

sachets.prompt: Pia wants Lavender Sachets. A Drying Bench takes lavender in and sends sachets to the Packing Station.

bouquet.prompt: Ada wants 1 Mixed Bouquet. Give an Arrangement Table one Daisy Bundle and one Lavender Sachet, then belt it to the Packing Station.
